---
title: "A proof system (part&nbsp;1) with *emphasis* and `code` & R"
author: Jane Doe
date: 2025-04-30
citation: true
google-scholar: true
appendix-cite-as: [display, bibtex]
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ["meta[name=\"citation_title\"][content=\"A proof system (part\u00a01) with emphasis and code & R\"]"]
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-appendix-citeas em', '.quarto-appendix-bibtex']
        matches: ['Emphasis']
        noMatches: ['\*', '`', '&nbsp;']
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - ['\\emph\{Emphasis\}', 'Part~1']
---

Markdown formatting and entities in the title are converted before they reach the appendix citation, the BibTeX citation and the Google Scholar metadata.
